verdict.rationale: Kimi ships an official Kimi Code CLI. You run `kimi` in the terminal and authenticate with `/login`. It can then read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web and complete development tasks on its own, and it exposes an ACP protocol so editors like JetBrains and Zed can connect. A probe confirms the official docs, and a community user refers to the Kimi CLI directly, saying it outperformed OpenCode. Missing for 10: a detailed command and flag reference, and evidence of non-interactive or scriptable CLI use.
